resources.string: Applies only to this session on this server, on this device. New sessions and subagent sessions keep their own settings.
Allows every permission request in this session without asking, including commands and file access. Each request is approved once; questions still require an answer.
After a completed response, summarizes earlier context when the model reaches the threshold. Details may be lost. Requires a known model context limit.
Removes current alerts and suppresses completion, permission, question and error notifications for this session. The connection service notification remains visible.
